why: A household watches the films and shows it owns, on every screen it has.
It listens to the music it owns.
It watches live channels, and what it recorded of them.

goal: Look at photos and home videos
why: It looks at its own photos and home videos.
It listens to audiobooks and podcasts, and reads books.
To watch or listen, the platform has to know what the household owns: take it in, describe it, and make it ready to play on every device.
A household is several people: each signs in, sees what they may, and keeps a place, lists and a history of their own.
Somebody runs it: installs it, makes it reachable, keeps it up to date, backs it up, and learns when it fails.
The platform leaves things out on purpose; anyone adds them as an addon, without changing the platform.
Anyone can see what it does, check it, change it, and count on it staying open.
